question: Among the numbers \(3.14\), \(\sqrt{5}\), \(-\pi\), \(0.1010010001\ldots\) (with one more \(0\) between each successive pair of consecutive \(1\)s), \(\sqrt{16}\), \(22/7\), and \(\sqrt[3]{8}\), how many are irrational?
solution: \(\sqrt{5}\), \(-\pi\), and \(0.1010010001\ldots\) (nonterminating and nonrepeating) are irrational. \(3.14\), \(\sqrt{16}=4\), \(22/7\), and \(\sqrt[3]{8}=2\) are all rational. There are \(3\) irrational numbers in total.
